name: 2023 Pre-Qingming Ancient Tree Raw Pu-erh Tasting Collection
marketing_tip: A curated selection of 2023's finest pre-spring harvests, capturing the diverse terroir and vibrant vitality of Yunnan's premier ancient tea forests.
body: This collection features raw Pu-erh tea harvested before the Qingming festival in 2023, a period prized for producing the most tender and flavorful leaves. Sourced from various prestigious tea-growing regions in Yunnan, this tasting set allows enthusiasts to explore the subtle nuances and bold expressions of ancient tree harvests in their purest, youngest form.
